words.prose: {{ar:يَسْطُرُونَ}} ({{tr:yasṭurūn}}) closes the ayah on continuing plural activity rather than a completed record. The ending supplies a plural agent, but the agent is unnamed; the preceding {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) gives the verb an object slot while keeping the written content open. The s-t-r root makes writing a matter of setting separate marks into visible lines, ordered rows, and sequence, distinct from a k-t-b frame of binding or obligation; related line-ruling evidence sharpens that ordering image while the local Form I verb keeps the action broad. Nearby {{ar:ٱلْقَلَمِ}} ({{tr:al-qalami}}) selects ordinary inscription over other root branches such as magical writing, while the same root's later asāṭīr usage makes the opening act of inscription answer a polemical label in the same surah (68:15; also 8:31; 16:24). The final verb therefore gathers ongoing agency, open content, line-making order, and a later contested writing echo into the oath's last beat. Its sibilant-emphatic texture and final nasal ending also answer the opening letter as an audible frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath joins ٱلْقَلَمِ at word 2 to the open object مَا and the plural verb يَسْطُرُونَ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A prepared writing instrument produces ordered rows one after another; the open object keeps both the content and the writers plural rather than reducing the oath to one document.

activation_trace.role: The trimmed writing reed supplies the oath's concrete instrument and its capacity to make durable signs.
The aligned written row supplies the cumulative product and makes inscription an ordering operation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely swears by a pen and writing.
changed_reading.after: The ayah foregrounds a material process in which a prepared instrument repeatedly orders otherwise open content into transmissible rows.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَلَم and يَسْطُرُونَ can be held together through their shared material imagery of cutting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The instrument is made by paring a hard object, and the resulting line can itself be imagined as a strike or cut. Writing is therefore not neutral notation but a controlled incision that creates a boundary and leaves a trace.

activation_trace.role: Paring a hard thing smooth supplies the tool-making cut and gives the pen disciplined material form.
The striking or cutting line turns the written stroke into an incision that divides a field.

changed_reading.before: Writing passively represents something already settled.
changed_reading.after: Inscription actively cuts a stable distinction into a surface, so the oath concerns the force by which order is made visible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun قَلَم can activate a casting stick while يَسْطُرُونَ supplies ordered rows.
baseline_models.mechanism: A cast lot selects or assigns, after which the row fixes the assignment in an ordered series. On this branch-distant baseline, inscription and allotment are neighboring operations: both turn open possibilities into positioned outcomes.

activation_trace.role: The trimmed casting stick used for lots supplies selection and allocation among possibilities.
The aligned row supplies the ordered placement in which selected outcomes can be fixed.

changed_reading.before: The pen only records decisions made elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: The pen can also image the allocation that selects and positions outcomes, with the row preserving the resulting order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open مَا and plural يَسْطُرُونَ do not identify either the content's truth or the writers' authority.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same inscription field can hold an ordered record, fabricated tales, or supervisory control. The oath can thus foreground the power and risk of script without treating every written product as self-authenticating.

activation_trace.role: The writing reed supplies the common medium whose authority remains undecided by the instrument alone.
False written tales supply script's capacity to fabricate an apparently ordered account.
Overseeing control supplies the competing possibility that ordered inscription preserves by exercising authority.

changed_reading.before: Writing is authoritative simply because it is writing.
changed_reading.after: Writing is a contested technology that may preserve, fabricate, or control; the ayah swears by its consequential power while leaving its products to be tested.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered external trace of writing is recruited into a sequence about covered reason, assay, sight, and distinguishing knowledge. Inscription becomes evidence that exposes and tests orientation rather than merely storing speech.

activation_trace.role: The aligned written row supplies publicly inspectable order against which a cognitive accusation can be tested.
The covering of reason by madness supplies the alleged hidden impairment that the ordered trace counters.
The assay of metal or person supplies a discriminating test rather than an unsupported label.
A distinguishing mark that guides to its object makes the written line function as evidence of orientation.

structural_cues: The pen oath is followed immediately by the negated madness label, then by seeing, testing, and knowing in 68:5-7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered rows, covered reason, assay, and a guiding mark; I infer that the external trace answers the hidden-mind accusation by making orientation testable. Alternatively, the oath may only precede the denial without serving as its evidence.

changed_reading.before: The inscription is an honored object independent of the accusation that follows.
changed_reading.after: The inscription is also a forensic trace: visible order contests the claim of covered reason and enters an assay of who is actually disoriented.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening instrument exists because it has been cut into shape, yet the following reward is explicitly imaged as not cut down or diminished. Finite strokes become a carrier for continuity that outlasts each bounded mark.

activation_trace.role: The pared hard object supplies a deliberately bounded and cut-made instrument.
Cutting and diminution until extension ceases supplies the exact interruption negated of the reward.

structural_cues: The cut-made qalam in 68:1 is followed within two ayat by a reward described through negated interruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut instrument and a non-cut extension; I infer a paradox in which bounded acts of inscription transmit an unbounded consequence. Alternatively, the two cutting images may remain independent lexical effects.

changed_reading.before: Each written stroke is a finite mark on a finite surface.
changed_reading.after: The finite, cut-made stroke can mediate an extension that is itself not cut off, separating the bounded act from its continuing consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paring and aligning are brought beside the measuring of a thing and an inward disposition. The pen image can therefore disclose character as a formed proportion made legible in repeated conduct, not as an ornamental compliment detached from process.

activation_trace.role: Paring a hard thing into a serviceable form supplies disciplined formation.
The aligned row supplies repeatable outward order through which an inward quality becomes legible.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies the calibration side of character formation.
The inward disposition supplies the ethical material whose stable pattern is manifested outwardly.

structural_cues: 68:4 places the great inward disposition directly after the pen, inscription, denial, and enduring reward sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tool shaping, aligned repetition, proportion, and inward disposition; I infer that repeated ordered action reveals a measured character. Alternatively, the character statement may be praise with no formative connection to the pen.

changed_reading.before: The pen records a character already complete and externally describable.
changed_reading.after: The pen images disciplined formation, while its aligned traces make the proportion of an inward disposition publicly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact paring and a maintained line are set against reciprocal soft accommodation. The opening writing image can become an ethics of contour: a line must remain definite even when each side is invited to smooth itself toward the other.

activation_trace.role: Controlled paring smooths hard material while preserving the exact tip needed to draw a definite line.
The aligned row supplies a contour whose integrity depends on maintained direction.
Softness of accommodation and dissimulation supplies the social pressure to blur the line reciprocally.

structural_cues: 68:9 repeats the d-h-n form on both sides, making the proposed accommodation reciprocal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precision-shaping, alignment, and mutual soft accommodation; I infer an opposition between a usable smoothness that sharpens a line and a political smoothness that erases it. A live alternative is that the qalam's own smoothing makes writing capable of varnish as well as resistance.

changed_reading.before: The written line is only a visual arrangement.
changed_reading.after: The written line also models maintained ethical contour under pressure to make distinctions mutually soft and negotiable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root field forks between aligned inscription and fabricated written tales precisely when visible signs are recited and dismissed. The context confirms that the pen's medium does not authenticate itself; truth and fabrication compete inside script.

activation_trace.role: The aligned written row supplies inscription's ordered and record-like face.
False written tales supply the explicit counterfeit use of the same inscription field.
The visible sign supplies the evidence that is being redescribed as fabricated writing.

structural_cues: 68:15 places recitation of the signs, a speech act, and the s-t-r-derived accusation in one compact sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered row, false written tales, and a visible sign; I infer an adversarial fork in which script can either answer to signs or overwrite them with a counterfeit account. Alternatively, the open مَا in 68:1 may include both parties' productions without assigning one branch to each.

changed_reading.before: The pen oath certifies written discourse as such.
changed_reading.after: The oath opens a contest within written discourse: alignment on a page can preserve a sign or lend fabricated tales the appearance of order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The material line migrates from a prepared tool and cut surface to a bodily surface. Inscription becomes not only propositional writing but a mark that fixes social exposure on the very organ associated with proud presentation.

activation_trace.role: The pared hard tool supplies the implement side of a material marking process.
The striking or cutting line supplies a mark that can be transferred by analogy from page to body.
The nose or snout supplies the exposed bodily surface on which the structural marking action lands.

structural_cues: The w-s-m marking verb in 68:16 has no branch inventory and is used only here as an uncited structural cue.
The bodily mark follows immediately after the charge that recited signs are false writings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut-made implement, a cutting line, an uncited marking construction, and a nose/snout; I infer a page-to-body transfer in which denied signs return as embodied exposure. Alternatively, the bodily punishment image may be independent of the opening pen.

changed_reading.before: Inscription remains on an external writing surface.
changed_reading.after: Inscription can become embodied and reputational: the contested account is answered by a mark carried on the exposed self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pen's casting-lot branch is activated by a story of allocating, cutting, depriving, and hoping for substitution. The owners try to fix a share-pattern through resolve and harvest; the garden is cut first, reversing who controls the allotment.

activation_trace.role: The trimmed casting stick used for lots supplies the opening image of selection and assigned shares.
Separating a share and dividing a thing supplies the owners' attempted allocation of the harvest.
Cutting and separation supply the planned harvest and the mechanism that rebounds on the garden.
Deprivation and loss of the sought object supply the reversed result of the owners' exclusionary plan.
One thing standing in place of another supplies the hoped-for revision after the failed allotment.

structural_cues: Across 68:17-32, the intended cutting, the already cut result, deprivation, blame, and hoped substitution form a reversal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a qalam-lot, division, cutting, deprivation, and substitution; I infer that the garden episode dramatizes an attempted human inscription of shares being overwritten by a counter-allotment. Alternatively, the lot branch may be only a remote lexical echo of a story about harvest ethics.

changed_reading.before: The pen records an allocation after its terms are secure.
changed_reading.after: The pen images allocation itself, while the garden sequence shows that an exclusionary share-pattern can be cut through, reversed, and replaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening medium becomes the object of a documentary cross-examination: where is the binding text, who has studied it, what judgment does it establish, and who guarantees the claim? Script acquires authority only through warranted content and accountable custody.

activation_trace.role: The writing reed supplies the documentary medium whose authority is put under examination.
Judgment between people supplies the legal claim for which documentary warrant is demanded.
A written establishment that makes a judgment or decree binding supplies the alleged proof-text.
Following a book through reading and retention supplies accountable engagement with the alleged document.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the accountable person required to stand behind the written claim.

structural_cues: The questions in 68:36-41 move from judgment to book, study, choice, enduring oaths, guarantor, and partners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judgment, a binding text, study, and a guarantor; I infer a chain of documentary validity from inscription through interpretation to accountability. Alternatively, each question may independently expose unsupported privilege without defining a general theory of writing.

changed_reading.before: A written line carries authority by existing.
changed_reading.after: A written line bears a burden of proof: its judgment, reading, custody, and guarantor must all withstand examination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Aligned rows are converted into a temporal process by stepwise taking and a root inventory that holds both extended time and dictation of a book. What is inscribed can unfold event by event, as though duration itself were being dictated into successive lines.

activation_trace.role: The aligned row supplies the line-by-line form into which temporal events can accumulate.
Taking degree by degree supplies the incremental movement from one temporal line to the next.
Extension of time and granting delay supply the duration across which the inscription unfolds.
Dictation of a book supplies the explicit bridge from granted time to successive inscription.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 places gradual taking immediately beside extended respite and a firm plan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aligned rows, degree-by-degree movement, temporal extension, and book dictation; I infer that delay is not empty but a process in which consequences are successively written. Alternatively, the dictation branch may be a lexical neighbor with no causal role in the respite.

changed_reading.before: What they inscribe is a completed archive viewed all at once.
changed_reading.after: Inscription is also processive: time supplies successive lines, and apparent delay can be the interval in which the record and its consequences take form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah's unspecified مَا is later confronted by a pointed question: do the writers possess what is hidden from sight such that they can write it? Inscription is bounded by access; fluent rows cannot substitute for epistemic warrant.

activation_trace.role: The aligned written row supplies formal coherence, which the later question separates from warranted knowledge.
Something concealed from eyes supplies the inaccessible object that would have to be possessed before it could be written with authority.
Joining letters into written form supplies the act whose epistemic basis is challenged.

structural_cues: 68:47 puts possession of the unseen and their writing in a direct rhetorical dependency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed content and writing in a direct question; I infer that access is a necessary warrant for authoritative inscription. Alternatively, the question may target only the opponents' claims and leave the opening writers unrestricted.

changed_reading.before: The open object مَا permits writing to range over any claimed content.
changed_reading.after: The openness of مَا becomes an epistemic test: ordered writing remains accountable to whether its writers have access to what they claim to inscribe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The written row enters a circuit of hearing, understanding, recall, speech, and documentary right. Inscription is not a static endpoint; it stabilizes material that can be heard, remembered, voiced, and carried across audiences.

activation_trace.role: The aligned written row supplies the stable material substrate for later circulation.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies reception that goes beyond acoustic contact.
Bringing something back after forgetting, or holding it in memory, supplies mnemonic persistence.
A record or deed of right supplies the reminder's documentary force rather than reducing it to private recollection.

structural_cues: 68:51 moves from hostile sight to hearing the reminder, and 68:52 closes by expanding the reminder's audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written rows, understanding by hearing, restored memory, and a documentary right; I infer a cross-media circulation from script to reception and recall. Alternatively, the closing reminder may be primarily oral and need not depend on the opening pen.

changed_reading.before: Writing fixes content in place on a surface.
changed_reading.after: Writing stabilizes content so that it can leave the page, become heard understanding, return as memory, and function as a public warrant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves s-t-r from written rows into bodily alignment and bending. It remains anchored in يَسْطُرُونَ through the row branch and is activated by the later demanded prostration; downstream prose should present it as a spatial analogy, not redefine the verb as prostrating people.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The row-making force of يَسْطُرُونَ is read spatially against the later call for bodies to bend.

activation_trace.role: The aligned row supplies an order that can be analogically extended from marks on a page to arranged bodies.
Bowing the head and bending supplies the bodily transformation that tests whether alignment can become responsive posture.
Lowering and submission supply the embodied state that arrives after the failed call to bend.

changed_reading.before: Rows are inert arrangements of graphic marks.
changed_reading.after: Rows can image an embodied order whose truth is tested when aligned subjects are called to change posture rather than merely occupy position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The packet gives no branch inventory for the isolated نٓ and does not lexically identify it with the fish, so this cannot decode the opening letter. It remains anchored to the literal initial sign and the late fish-companion sequence as a reconstructed formal echo; downstream prose must label it conjectural and avoid importing a settled identification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The otherwise opaque isolated نٓ is allowed to gather retrospective pressure from the fish, blocked interior, and threatened open exposure in 68:48-49.

activation_trace.role: The fish supplies the concrete late image that can retrospectively resonate with the isolated opening sign without equating the two.
A blocked outlet after filling supplies compression and enclosure around the fish episode.
An uncovered open expanse supplies the threatened reversal from compressed interior to exposed exterior.

changed_reading.before: نٓ remains an isolated sign with no active relation to the surah's later imagery.
changed_reading.after: Without being decoded, نٓ can function as a compressed opening hook whose opacity is reactivated by the late movement among fish, blockage, and exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the anomalous qalam branch of color-shifting cloth, so it is branch-distant even though the later hostile gaze and slipping image activate it sharply. It remains anchored in قَلَم and exact context branches; downstream prose should frame it as a perceptual analogy and never replace the writing pen with cloth in the base translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The qalam's unusual color-shifting branch is read against the hostile eyes that nearly dislodge the addressee in 68:51.

activation_trace.role: A cloth whose colors shift to viewers supplies perceptual instability inside the qalam inventory.
Slipping from one's standing place on a surface that gives no footing supplies attempted perceptual dislodgment.
Vision by the eye supplies the hostile viewing condition under which appearance and footing become unstable.

changed_reading.before: The pen and its product remain visually stable regardless of their viewers.
changed_reading.after: The qalam can image a sign exposed to adversarial perception, where hostile viewing tries to shift appearance and dislodge the bearer even while the written reminder persists.

strongest_changes: The opening inscription becomes a cognitive assay: visible order answers the covered-reason accusation and participates in distinguishing orientation.
The same s-t-r field produces both aligned record and false tale, while the later unseen-writing question makes epistemic access, not graphic order, the criterion of authority.
The qalam's cutting and lot branches turn the garden sequence into a counter-allotment in which an exclusionary share-pattern is itself cut through and replaced.
Stepwise taking, temporal extension, and book dictation make inscription processive: consequences can be written line by line through time.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms without requiring a final choice: inscription records, cuts, allocates, tests, forms, can counterfeit, unfolds in time, and circulates as memory. The strangest packet-backed activations moved the line onto the body, turned rows into posture, and placed the anomalous color-shifting qalam under a hostile gaze.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal force of immediate sequencing remains uncertain: several strong deltas may be deliberate adjacency or only compatible juxtaposition.
The supervisory s-t-r branch and the qalam color-cloth branch are form- or domain-distant and should not control an unqualified rendering.
The نٓ/fish echo is deliberately retained as a formal conjecture, not a lexical identification or imported decoding.
The allotment and bodily-row models are coherent material analogies, but the packet does not force them over the ordinary writing model.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Writing as ordered alignment.** `ق ل م B003` identifies the trimmed writing reed and `س ط ر B001` the aligned written row. The coordinated oath joins instrument to repeated human action. I infer that trimming enables controlled alignment; the ayah therefore foregrounds writing as disciplined ordering, not merely inscription.
2. **Cutting that produces accountable lines.** The material branches `ق ل م B001/B006` (paring or cutting tool) and `س ط ر B004` (cutting a line) are activated by the later crop sequence `ح ر ث`/`ص ر م` in 68:17-25. Packet elements supply pens, rows, cultivation, and cutting; I supply the analogy that both textual and agricultural order emerge by bounded cuts. The oath can thus be heard as anticipating the decisive separations by which claims, shares, and deeds become legible.
3. **True rows versus fabricated rows.** `س ط ر B002` permits false written tales, but 68:15 explicitly calls the recited signs *asāṭīr*. Its reuse of the same root supplies a reversal: the opening honors actual line-making, while the denier redescribes revelation as fabricated compilation. I infer a contest over the status of inscription; the ayah becomes the standard against which 68:15's dismissal is exposed.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:17-25 made the pen's cut edge newly visible through cultivation and severing, while 68:37, 68:45, and 68:47 extended the opening from inscription to book, dictation, and contested writing. Most surprising was 68:15: the same ordered-row root becomes the denier's label for fabricated tales.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The pen as an allocating instrument under uncertainty.** Fixed `قَلَم` activates `ق ل م B004` (a trimmed stick used for drawing lots). The paired future seeing in 68:5 and the unresolved `بِأَييِّكُمُ` in 68:6 supply delayed disclosure and a choice between parties; I infer that the record will allocate the disputed description when what is now uncertain becomes visible. The oath can therefore evoke adjudicative allotment as well as ordinary writing.
2. **Rows that make opposed perceptions comparable.** Fixed `يَسْطُرُونَ` activates `س ط ر B001` (aligned written row), and 68:5 places “you will see” beside “they will see.” The packet supplies alignment and a mirrored pair; I infer that being set into one record makes the two perspectives answerable to the same sequence. Writing reads as a comparison structure, not merely an accumulation of marks.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:5-6 unexpectedly turned fixed `قَلَم` from writing tool into `ق ل م B004`, an allocating lot: mirrored future sight precedes the question of which party bears the tested label. The later grammar supplied the adjudicative function.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A surface becomes socially legible when lines, colors, marks, or attached signs assign content and identity to it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The opening pen and closing facial brand belong to one material semiotics: inscription may preserve truth, fabricate reputation, or fasten an identity to a body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pared Reed, Ordered Rows, and Audible Inscription
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hard tip is pared into a writing tool; it lays down ordered rows whose fine traces can even be imagined as a faint sound.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: successive paring (`quranic:root_001252:B001/m01`); writing reed (`quranic:root_001252:B003/m01`); cutting shears (`quranic:root_001252:B006/m01`); ordered written rows (`quranic:root_000704:B001/m01`); articulated statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); faint sound of writing (`quranic:root_001557:B003/m01`); close fine lines (`quranic:root_001557:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The pen is not an abstract emblem. Its point is produced by repeated cutting, then converts speech into aligned, durable traces. The minute noise and close lines supplied by `ن م م` make inscription a tactile and acoustic operation as well as a textual one.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Coating and Pattern Can Beautify or Misstate a Surface
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Oil, pigment, dye, and fine patterning alter a body or textile until its visible state may conceal its underlying condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: oil coating (`quranic:root_000497:B001/m01`); soft social dissimulation (`quranic:root_000497:B002/m01`); iridescent cloth (`quranic:root_001252:B010/m01`); patterned cloth that “lies” by appearance (`quranic:root_001290:B009/m01`); close ornamental lines (`quranic:root_001557:B007/m02`); contrasting fleck or gleam (`quranic:root_001557:B008/m01`); perfumed pigment (`quranic:root_000434:B010/m01`); visible beauty mark (`quranic:root_001650:B005/m01`); dye-bearing plant (`quranic:root_001650:B006/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The reciprocal “oiling” of 68:9 expands into a surface technology. Applied substances and textile patterns can produce genuine adornment, but they can also make an appearance assert what the underlying material does not warrant.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mastery as Care, Knowledge, and Watch
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A master owns and tends what is under charge; learned oversight and watchful supervision preserve and direct it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lordship and ownership (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); gradual nurture and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); cultivated authoritative knowledge (`quranic:root_000532:B003/m01`); captain of sailors (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`); supervising controller (`quranic:root_000704:B003/m01`); chief whose word carries (`quranic:root_001272:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The master is not only an owner but a cultivator, knower, captain, and watcher. These roles clarify why the pericope repeatedly locates final knowledge of direction and error with the `رَبّ`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Shield, cutting weapon, spear-part, and heavy tool produce capture; authority may then release the captive without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m02`); armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m02`); sword-cut or butcher’s blade (`quranic:root_000704:B004/m01`); pared spear-tip or shaft (`quranic:root_001252:B005/m01`); crowbar or heavy club (`quranic:root_000980:B003/m01`); release of a captive without exchange (`quranic:root_001449:B004/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A dwelling is assembled, marriage initiates a household, children and livestock increase it, and food builds its members’ flesh.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: house built by joined parts (`quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`); marriage and entry into household (`quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`); descent and filiation (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); food building flesh (`quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`); accumulated wealth (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); growth of livestock and offspring (`quranic:root_001427:B003/m01`); bride-gift (`quranic:root_001583:B004/m01`); bride conducted to spouse (`quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`); bridal payment (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m02`); separation from a spouse (`quranic:root_001252:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: “Wealth and sons” expands into a household production scene: architecture, marriage, payment, descent, nourishment, and animal increase. Its reverse is equally concrete in spousal separation and arrested circulation of wealth.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covered Garden, Grain Ear, and Aromatic Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water drives enclosing vegetation upward; grain extends into ears, low plants spread, and aromatic growth announces itself by scent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense rising vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); persistent green plant (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`); extended grain ear (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); low salt plant (`quranic:root_001252:B007/m01`); halfa grass (`quranic:root_000349:B005/m01`); aromatic plant disclosed by smell (`quranic:root_001557:B004/m01`); summer browse after spring (`quranic:root_000993:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a succession of plant forms rather than a generic “nature” motif. Enclosure, upward density, earing grain, low browse, and scent each mark a different stage or mode by which provision occupies the land.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Fitted Parts Make Shelters, Implements, and Cuts
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material becomes functional by cutting, joining, tensioning, or arranging parts into a load-bearing whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The writing tool belongs to a larger craft world of stitched leather, tent frames, bows, lots, clubs, and terminal cuts; “whole” and “part” are physical operations before they become discourse categories.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lot-Arrows and Game-Sticks Turn Cut Wood into Decision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Pared shafts are collected in a container, cast as lots, or used as striking sticks, turning shaped wood into an instrument of selection or play.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lot-arrow (`quranic:root_001252:B004/m01`); hide container holding arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); stick for striking a game-piece (`quranic:root_001272:B008/m01`); heavy levering tool (`quranic:root_000980:B003/m02`); carrying implement (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m02`); saddle timber (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cutting does not predetermine use. The same shaped wood can write, strike, lever, or enter a lot, so material preparation precedes a social decision about the implement’s operation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Successive Cutting Ends a Line, Bond, or Life
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A blade removes material piece by piece until a line, cord, relation, or living duration is interrupted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: repeated paring (`quranic:root_001252:B001/m02`); shears (`quranic:root_001252:B006/m02`); sword-line cut (`quranic:root_000704:B004/m02`); cutting and diminution of duration (`quranic:root_001449:B001/m01`); last breath (`quranic:root_000186:B008/m01`); imposed separation (`quranic:root_000131:B003/m01`); destruction or expulsion from good (`quranic:root_000131:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The concrete act of cutting supplies a precise contrast to the reward that is `غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ`: the reward neither runs down nor reaches the last severed point. The same operation also explains how separation becomes social or mortal.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tırnak kesmede kullanılan iki ağızlı kesici aracı ve bu araç için kullanılan özel biçimleri verir. Dalın araç anlamı sağlamdır, ancak mekanik sözlükselleşme profili çıplak anlamı değil listelenmiş özel birimleri desteklediğinden tanım bu birimlerle sınırlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal kesme işleminin kendisi ya da her tür kesici değil, listelenmiş özel adlarla karşılanan iki ağızlı kesme aracıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız kanıtta listelenen özel araç adlarına bağlı tutulur; kökün yalın biçimine genel bir kesici araç anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Tırnak veya benzeri şeyleri iki karşılıklı ağız arasında kesmeye yarayan, kanıtta özel ad biçimleriyle sözlükselleşmiş bir kesme aracıdır.

facets.statement: İki karşılıklı kesici ağız, tırnak veya benzeri bir şeyi araya alıp keser.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar tırnak kesme bağlamında iki ağızlı bir kesme aracını gösterir ve araç için birden fazla özel ad biçimi aktarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Özel birimlerin ortak referenti olan karşılıklı ağızlarla kesen aracı doğal ve kapsayıcı biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Somut araç niteliğini, iki ağızlı yapıyı ve kesme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aracın doğrudan tırnak kesmek için kullanıldığı cümlelerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aracın tırnak üzerinde kullanılan somut bir kesici olmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı iki ağızlı aracın başka şeyleri kesebilme kapsamını daraltır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, iki karşılıklı ağızla kapanarak kesen ve özel adlarla belirtilen araca özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal genel kesme araçlarını, keskin kılıçları ve kısa geniş bıçak ya da ok uçlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da keskin bir bölümle maddi bir şeyi kesmeye yarayan somut araçları içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın referenti iki ağızlı ve kapanarak kesen belirli araçtır; karşı dalın kapsamı yapı bakımından daha geniştir ve kılıç ile tek ağızlı uçları da içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kesici ağız, testere, sivriltilmiş uç ve kılıç adayları karşılaştırıldı; genel kesici araç dalı iki ağızlı yapı sınırını en açık biçimde gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, tuzlu toprak bitkileri arasında sayılan ve gövdesi bulunmayan belirli bir bitkiyi açıkça tanımlar. Dal çerçevesi bunun kökün kesme anlamından ayrı bir bitki adı olduğunu doğru biçimde belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel olarak bitki ya da tuzcul bitki değil, kanıtta gövdesiz oluşuyla tanınan belirli bir tür adıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal belirli gövdesiz tuzcul bitkiyi adlandırır; kesme, yazı aracı veya coğrafi bölge anlamları buna taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tuzlu topraklarda yetişen bitkiler grubundan, belirgin bir gövdesi bulunmayan belirli bir bitki türüdür.

facets.statement: Belirli bitki, tuzlu topraklara uyumlu bir gruba girer ve belirgin bir gövde taşımaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bunun ana kesme anlamından ayrı bir bitki adı olduğunu, tuzcul bitkiler arasında yer aldığını ve gövdesiz oluşunu aktarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bitkinin yaşam alanı grubunu ve ayırt edici gövdesizlik özelliğini birlikte veren açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir bitki oluşunu, tuzcul niteliğini ve gövdesizliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitkinin kısa ve otsu görünümünün öne çıktığı betimleyici bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin gövdesizliğini ve tuzlu çevreyle ilişkili niteliğini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin referenti, yeryüzünün geleneksel olarak yediye ayrılan büyük bölümlerinden biridir. Komşu bölgeden kesilip ayrılmış sayılmasına dayanan açıklama bir türetim yorumudur; dalın doğrudan tanımı herhangi bir kesilmiş toprak parçasına genişletilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan bir arazi parçası değil, yeryüzünün büyük ve düzenli coğrafi bölümlerinden biridir; kesilmişlik yalnız adlandırma açıklamasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal büyük coğrafi bölgeyi adlandırır; yerel toprak parçası, sınır çizgisi veya belirli bir özel yer adı bu kapsama alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yeryüzünün geleneksel olarak yediye ayrıldığı düşünülen büyük coğrafi bölümlerden biridir; komşu bölümden ayrılmış sayılması adın türetimine ilişkin bir açıklamadır.

facets.statement: Referent, yeryüzünü oluşturan büyük coğrafi bölümlerden biri ve geleneksel yedili düzenin bir parçasıdır.
Adın, bölgenin komşu bölgeden kesilip ayrılmış sayılmasına bağlandığı bir türetim açıklaması verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar referenti yeryüzünün yedi büyük bölümünden biri olarak tanımlar; ayrıca adın komşu bölümden ayrılmış olma düşüncesiyle açıklanabildiğini aktarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Referentin coğrafi bölüm niteliğini ve yeryüzü ölçeğindeki kapsamını doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük coğrafi bölüm olmayı ve yeryüzü ölçeğindeki sınıflandırmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Geleneksel yedili coğrafya düzeninin özellikle açıklandığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük bölgeyi ve yedili bölümleme içindeki yerini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yeryüzü ölçeğinde kurulan geleneksel büyük bölümleme sisteminin bir birimini gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karşı dal, çevresinden görünüşü veya üzerindeki oluşumlar bakımından ayrılan yerel bir toprak parçasını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da çevresindeki yerlerden ayırt edilen bir toprak alanını adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal büyük ve düzenli bir coğrafi sınıflandırma birimidir; karşı dal ise çevresinden farklı görünen herhangi bir yerel toprak parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Arazi parçası, sınır, özel yer ve yönetim çevresi adayları değerlendirildi; yerel toprak parçası büyük coğrafi bölüm sınırını en iyi gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, ortak anlam çekirdeği doğrulanmamış üç açıklamayı geçici olarak bir arada tutar: ekşimsi bir içecek, göğe yükselen toz ve hayvanlarla ilgili anlamı belirsiz bir söz. Bunlar yapısal inceleme olmadan tek bir sözlük anlamında birleştirilemez.

facets.statement: Bir açıklamada söz, içinde ekşilik bulunan bir içecek türünü gösterir.
Başka bir açıklamada söz, göğe doğru yükselen tozu gösterir ve biçimin başka bir sözcükten gelmiş olabileceği belirtilir.
Üçüncü açıklama hayvanlarla ilgili bir söz verir, ancak sağlanan bağlam anlamı güvenle belirlemeye yetmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: İnceleme statüsündeki kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok biçime veya özel bağlama bağlı sınırlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki dağınık veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, birinin yanlış yaptığını doğrudan söylemek yerine belirli bir sözle dolaylı biçimde anlatmayı ve buna bağlı adın yanlış yapma anlamını açıkça verir. Dal çerçevesi hem söz kalıbının örtük anlatım işlevini hem de eylem adını doğru biçimde sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel yanlış yapma anlamını taşır, ancak söz kalıbındaki kullanım özellikle kişinin yanılmasını dolaylı biçimde bildirmeye bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dolaylı anlatım sağlayan söz kalıbı ile yanlış yapmayı adlandıran biçim ayrılır; kalıbın örtük işlevi her kullanıma yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yanlış yapması ve bu yanılmanın belirli bir sözle doğrudan söylenmeden, dolaylı biçimde bildirilmesidir. Aynı dalda bulunan eylem adı doğrudan yanlış yapmayı gösterir.

facets.statement: Kişi yanlış yapar ve bu durum belirli bir sözle dolaylı biçimde bildirilir.
Eylem adı, yanlış yapma veya yanılma durumunu doğrudan adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu anlam tek bir tanıklıkla sınırlıdır ve hem dolaylı bildirim sağlayan söz kalıbını hem de yanlış yapmayı adlandıran biçimi içerir.

source_details.summary: Bir kişinin o gün yanlış yaptığı dolaylı bir sözle bildirilir; buna bağlı eylem adı yanlış yapma anlamındadır.

concept_gloss.text: yanlış yapma ve bunu dolaylı yoldan söyleme

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yönü şaşırma, istemeden yanlış sonuç doğurma ve kötülüğün kişiyi ıskalamasını dileme gibi daha geniş kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dolaylı yanlış bildirimi ile genel yanılma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir kişinin doğru sonuca ulaşamaması ve yanlış yapması çekirdeğinde örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birinin yanlışını örtük biçimde haber veren belirli söyleyişe sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Söz, yazı veya hesapta sürçme ile harf ya da sözcük düşürme ve çıkarma sonuçlarını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sözde, eylemde veya başka bir işte yapılan yanlışı anlatabilir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız küçükbaş hayvanlardan genç erkek yavruyu adlandırır; türün tamamına, dişi yavruya veya genel hayvan adına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Küçükbaş hayvanlardan genç erkek bir yavruyu adlandıran yalın bir hayvan adıdır.

facets.statement: Gönderge, küçükbaş hayvanlar içinde genç ve erkek bir yavrudur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal küçükbaş hayvan ve özellikle keçi alanında aynı canlı grubuna gönderimde bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yaş ve cinsiyetçe sınırlı bir yavru adıdır; komşu dal keçi türünün genel adı ve çeşitli üyelerini kapsayan geniş bir sınıftır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir genç erkek küçükbaş yavruyu yaş ve cinsiyet özellikleriyle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koyun türünü, erkek ve dişi üyeleriyle ve çeşitli çoğul biçimleriyle genel olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genç erkek yavru ile koyun türü
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal küçükbaş hayvanların koyun çevresindeki adlandırma alanında kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli yaş ve cinsiyetteki bireydir; komşu dal yaş ve cinsiyet ayrımı yapmadan koyun türünün genel adlandırmasını verir.
